settings.headline: Small on purpose
settings.body:
Halverline is eight people in Portland, Maine and a few time zones east. We take on a handful of projects at a time, and the people in the first workshop are the ones who launch the site.

Every site is built on an open-source stack the client owns, with no per-seat or per-site license fees as they grow. More about the studio.

items.label: of clients stay on a care plan

settings.headline: Four phases, one team
settings.intro: A fixed price, a weekly update in the client portal, and the same people from start to finish.

items.title: Discover
items.text: Workshops, a content audit and a written scope. Two to three weeks.

items.title: Design
items.text: Sitemap, wireframes and visual design, reviewed with you every week.

items.title: Build
items.text: Content types, templates and migration on staging, with your editors involved early.

items.title: Care
items.text: Launch, then hosting and improvements on a care plan, or a full handover.

settings.quote: Halverline gave us a site our curators can run themselves, and the code is ours. When we moved hosting in-house, it was an afternoon, not a project.
settings.name: Dr. Amara Quist
settings.role: Director of collections, Hollowmere Museum of Craft (fictional)

settings.headline: Planning a new site?
settings.text: Tell us what you are working on. We reply within two working days with questions, not a sales deck. This demo has no forms; the button goes to the contact page.
